content.trans: 你看起来不太好。

content.text: No, you feel terrible.
content.trans: 英语：No, you feel terrible.

content.text: I went out last night with Trevor and things got a little out of hand.
content.trans: 英语：我昨晚和泰瑞克一起去，事情有点失控。

content.text: Nice.
content.trans: 好。

content.text: So where did you guys go?
content.trans: 英语：所以你们去哪儿了？

content.text: Well, we hit up a couple of local bars and met up with some friends.
content.trans: 嗯，我们去了几个当地的酒吧，并和一些朋友聚会。

content.text: Everything was cool until Mike came along.
content.trans: 一切都很顺利，直到迈克出现。

content.text: And it turned out that it was his birthday yesterday.
content.trans: And it turned out that it was his birthday yesterday. (注：原句为英文，但根据您的要求翻译成中文。)

content.text: Oh, no.
content.trans: 英语：啊，不。

content.text: Mike's birthday is a drink fest for sure.
content.trans: 英语：Mike的生日是一场喝得满头大汗的派对。

content.text: And tell me about it.
content.trans: 英语：And tell me about it.

content.text: We drink everything in the bar.
content.trans: 我们都在酒吧里喝酒。

content.text: Is that why you missed work today?
content.trans: 英语：是啊，你今天为什么没上班？

content.text: Yeah, I woke up this morning feeling really nauseous.
content.trans: 嗯，我今天早上感觉特别不舒服。

content.text: I threw up like five times.
content.trans: 我吐了五次。

content.text: Ew.
content.trans: 英语：Ew.

content.text: I was so dehydrated that I drank a gallon of water.
content.trans: 我太脱水了，所以我喝了一壶水。

content.text: And my head has been pounding all day.
content.trans: 我的脑袋今天一直都在发涨。

content.text: I swear, I am never going to drink again.
content.trans: 我誓不罢休，再也不喝酒了。

content.text: Too bad, man.
content.trans: 英语：太可惜了，先生。

content.text: Tonight is Tracy's going away party.
content.trans: 今天是汤姆的告别聚会。

content.text: And she asked if you were going to go.
content.trans: 她问你是否要去。

content.text: Oh, yeah?
content.trans: 英语：哦，对了。

content.text: I'm there.
content.trans: 我在这里。

content.text: So it sounds like these guys sure like to go out and have a few drinks, don't they?
content.trans: 英语：所以他们似乎非常喜欢出去喝点酒，对吧？

content.text: Yeah, exactly.
content.trans: 是的，正好。

content.text: And I think this is a very common thing among young people usually in the United States.
content.trans: 在我看来，美国年轻人普遍认为这是一个非常常见的事情。

content.text: You know, after a day at the office or something they'll go or even Europe they'll go to the pub, right?
content.trans: 是的，你懂的。工作一天或者什么，他们可能会去酒吧或欧洲旅游，对吧？

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: But the thing is that in America and Canada, we're very careful about alcohol and young people, right?
content.trans: 但是在美国和加拿大，我们非常小心地对待酒精和年轻人，对吗？

content.text: Yeah, exactly.
content.trans: 是的，正好。

content.text: The legal drinking age in the most part of the United States is 21 years of age.
content.trans: 美国大部分地区酒驾年龄为21岁。

content.text: And really many parents or families will never let their children drink alcohol until they're 21.
content.trans: 而且，许多父母或家庭会永远不允许他们的孩子在21岁之前饮酒。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是该短语的翻译：

content.text: And also the laws that control alcohol like for example, on television, if you notice a
content.trans: 而且酒精的管理法律，例如电视上可以看到，如果注意到有。

content.text: TV commercial with a beer or a wine, you will never see the person actually drinking it.
content.trans: 英文：电视广告里有啤酒或红酒，你永远看不到那个人正在喝。

content.text: It's illegal.
content.trans: 英语：It's illegal.

content.text: Yeah, that's true.
content.trans: 是的，那也是真的。

content.text: While in other countries it's okay, you'll see people drinking it and having fun.
content.trans: 英语：在其他国家，这很好，你可以看到人们喝它并享受乐趣。

content.text: And these commercials they can only maybe put them close to their lips but not drink it.
content.trans: 这些广告他们只能大概把它们放在嘴边，但不能喝下去。

content.text: Interesting.
content.trans: 有趣。

content.text: I mean, another weird thing is that, you know, sometimes you might want to sit in your back garden or out on your,
content.trans: 我指的是，你可能想要坐在你的后院或者在户外。

content.text: your porch and have a beer after work, right?
content.trans: 你的后院，下班后喝点啤酒吧。

content.text: But in places it's totally illegal to do that.
content.trans: 但是，在那里，这样做是完全非法的。

content.text: You can't be outside with alcohol.
content.trans: 英语：你不能在外面喝酒。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是该短语的中文翻译：

content.text: You can't be seen drinking or you can't be on the sidewalk or on a bus drinking.
content.trans: 你不能在喝或在路上喝酒。

content.text: While in other places you can, right?
content.trans: 英语：在其他地方，你也可以。

content.text: You can just have a beer on the subway.
content.trans: 你可以在地铁上喝啤酒。

content.text: So it's a little bit different policies on alcohol control.
content.trans: 英语：所以它在酒精控制上有一些不同的政策。

content.text: What do you guys think about it?
content.trans: 英语：你认为这个怎么样？

content.text: Do you think it's correct?
content.trans: 是的，你认为它正确吗？

content.text: Or do you think maybe it's a little bit too exaggerated?
content.trans: 英语：或者你是不是觉得可能有点夸张？

content.text: Come to our website, www.englishpod.com and tell us about it.
content.trans: 来我们的网站，www.englishpod.com，告诉我们关于它。

content.text: All right. We'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请告诉我需要翻译的英文句子。

content.text: And until next time, thanks for downloading and goodbye.
content.trans: 英语：和下次再见，谢谢下载并再见。
